## Other funded projects

- **Fortification systematic review and meta-analysis** of salt, rice and wheat and their effect on anaemia, iron deficiency and other micronutrient deficiencies. Nutrition International, 2025–2026.
- **Anaemia and micronutrient deficiency in women of reproductive age** in Rajendra Nagar and L R Nagar, Bangalore (AMBK). Internal resources, 2024–2026.
- **OpenCap validation** for detecting artificial biomechanical conditions. Internal resources, 2025–2026.
